revision_action: Do not report the archived CNN or ViT numbers as a numerical baseline. Add a transparent limitation explaining why a controlled image-versus-tabular comparison was not performed, and contextualize the distinction using published image-based Gravity Spy work.
why_existing_results_are_not_comparable: The archived mini image experiment contains only 10 classes and has zero event overlap with the frozen tabular O3 cohort.
The full image metadata covers the 24-class frozen cohort, but the image files are not stored locally.
The archived image train/validation/test assignments differ from both frozen tabular split protocols.
Using a model trained with the archived image split would expose part of the frozen tabular test set during image-model training.
A controlled comparison would therefore require downloading the O3 images and retraining image models from scratch under the frozen grouped-random and chronological assignments.
